assertion: Gradient stop interpolation uses the computed color-interpolation property: sRGB by default, linearRGB when specified or inherited. Stop alpha remains unpremultiplied during interpolation. CSS overrides presentation attributes.

browser.reason: Reviewed all three browsers and native frames. Black-to-white midpoints are 128 in sRGB and 188 in linearRGB. Native differences are 13015 gradient pixels with a maximum channel delta of 1, confined to color rounding; geometry and translucent interpolation agree.
